title: Solar Chimney Light Well
brief: a light well / solar chimney that brings daylight down six levels

footprint.note: the 1x1-cell light pipe pierces six decks; the 2x2 head sits on the roof at level 6

requires.note: the heliostat head needs direct sun on the top deck
drones core a 1x1 hole through each of the six decks

capacity.note: ~70 klm of daylight per level at noon, falling off over 3 cells

air.note: stack-effect ventilation of the six levels it pierces

light_air.note: daylight on every pierced level: +0.3 next to the shaft, fading to 0 at 3 cells

land_value.note: daylight is the scarcest amenity in deep strata

construction.name: light pipe
construction.action: core a 1x1 hole through six decks and lower the reflective light pipe (sun pipe)

construction.name: frame
construction.action: stand the four frame posts that brace the pipe through the voids

construction.name: light shelves
construction.action: fit a light shelf and diffuser at every pierced floor

construction.name: heliostat head
construction.action: set the roof collar, the louvred chimney crown and the ring of tracking mirrors; calibrate
